links.outcome: Faithfulness, context recall and answer relevancy of knowledge-graph-grounded agentic RAG versus GPT-4, standard RAG and Graph RAG
links.effect: Agentic Graph RAG scored faithfulness 0.94, context recall 0.92, answer relevancy 0.91, and outperformed GPT-4, standard RAG, and Graph RAG across all metrics.
links.quote: It significantly outperformed baseline models (including GPT-4, standard RAG, and Graph RAG) across all evaluation metrics.

unlisted_practices: Self-correcting retrieve-evaluate-refine agentic loop for optimizing graph search strategies
Grounding LLM answers in a clinically verified domain knowledge graph

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a novel self-correcting Agentic Graph RAG architecture against baseline models on a QA dataset rather than testing an organizational deployment practice.
